title: Plan général du parcours — Sierre-Zinal
claims: The official course plan gives the full Sierre–Zinal route as 31 km, split into 11 km between Sierre and Chandolin and 20 km between Chandolin and Zinal.
The same page gives 'plus de 2 000 m de dénivelé positif' (more than 2,000 m of positive elevation gain) across forests, alpine pastures and alpine ridges.
The same page lists 9 refreshment points (food and drink), the zones accessible to the public, the fan zones, the altitudes of the main crossing points and the road closures for the route.
The same page notes that the Junior course (Chandolin–Zinal, 20 km) and the alternative tourist itineraries (St-Antoine / Niouc) are also shown on the map.
The same page carries a disclaimer that the information is subject to change and that the race rules, the authorities' orders and the on-site signage take precedence.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直取赛事官网法文版赛道总览页全文，抄录 31 km 的两段拆分、2,000 m 以上正爬升、地形描述、9 个补给点、公众区与 fan zone，以及页面自带的免责声明。
